resources.string: Keeps your remote\'s extra buttons working. remapd starts by itself after a restart, and whenever you open this app.

One-time setup, with a computer:
1. Copy remapd and remapd.conf to /data/local/tmp with adb (see the README).
2. On the computer, run: adb tcpip 5555
3. Select Set up. When the TV asks "Allow USB debugging?", tick "Always allow from this computer" and select Allow.

The app then lets itself switch wireless debugging on and off, turns off adb's 7-day authorization timeout so its key keeps working, exempts itself from battery restrictions, closes port 5555 and starts remapd.
